items.headline: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance
items.summary: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance 09 November 2026 Digital Finance and Innovation The European Central Bank (ECB), together with the European Commission and the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), is calling upon wholesale financial industry stakeholders to express their interest in joining the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG).

items.headline: US tech outages spark conversation on resilience in the age of AI
items.summary: From air traffic control systems to banks, and tech companies to government agencies, a spate of high-profile IT outages in the US is surfacing questions about what resilience looks like in an AI-driven world.

items.headline: I am the passenger: In Brussels at Google’s data sovereignty event
items.summary: I look through the window. What do I see? Physical embassies protected from local law, while cloud data stored with US giants remains exposed to foreign warrants.
